services.name: Events & Workshops
services.desc: Support the arts in your community at the 2026 KAA Silent Auction! Bid to win a diverse collection of regional artwork while sustaining The Kittery Art Association and our programming. Your support helps us achieve our mission: To cultivate a passion for the arts, create a lively arts community, and nurture, celebrate, and promote the work of local artists. 100% of proceeds will benefit the Kittery Art Association. Bidding for the auction opens online on September 5th and runs through September 19th.
